name: TSA
recent: TSA 在 2026 年 11 月 16 日公布季度业绩，并宣布第三次中期股息每股 1.25 仙。随后在 11 月 17 日发布股息除权与派发时间表。此外，大股东 MR CHEN KHAI VOON 在 11 月 5 日至 18 日期间多次申报股权变动。
notable: 宣布第三次中期单层股息每股 1.25 仙，除权日为 2026 年 12 月 1 日，派发日为 2026 年 12 月 16 日。
公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度的合并业绩。
大股东 MR CHEN KHAI VOON 在 11 月 5 日至 18 日期间多次申报股权变动。

recent_en: TSA announced its quarterly results on 16 November 2026 and declared a third interim dividend of 1.25 sen per share. It subsequently issued the dividend ex-date and payment schedule on 17 November. In addition, substantial shareholder MR CHEN KHAI VOON filed multiple changes in shareholding between 5 and 18 November.
notable_en: Declared a third interim single-tier dividend of 1.25 sen per share, with ex-date on 1 December 2026 and payment date on 16 December 2026.
Announced consolidated results for the quarter ended 30 September 2026.
Substantial shareholder MR CHEN KHAI VOON filed multiple changes in shareholding between 5 and 18 November.
